## Overview

MarkdStage v4.0.0 adds the Windows Desktop distribution package set. It improves the Windows Desktop
presenter and CLI workflow, including more reliable packaged-app launches, current-workspace
handling, Archify diagram imports, and PowerPoint export diagnostics and recovery. It also adds
Store-ready Windows packaging and desktop skill installation guidance.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Windows Desktop users. GitHub Releases now
include portable x64/ARM64 packages and signed sideloading MSIX packages. Microsoft Store
submission is a separate local Partner Center operation and is not performed by the GitHub
Release workflow.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.0.0`. |
| Canvas Extension | Install `.github/extensions/markdstage` from the `v4.0.0` tag. |
| CLI | Update `@markdstage/markdstage` to version `4.0.0`. |
| Desktop | Use the v4.0.0 Windows package for the matching architecture. |
| Microsoft Store | Create `MarkdStage-Store.msixupload` locally and submit it separately through Partner Center. |
